In this video Top Gear drives a pre-production prototype version of the new Ferrari Luce. It’s Ferrari’s most controversial car ever, not least because its design broke the internet when it was unveiled in May 2026. But how does it drive – and does that matter to those who believe every Ferrari must come with a combustion engine?
Ferrari Luce (prototype)
